name: Miniflux
description: Minimalist RSS reader — subscribe to feeds, read articles, and track news
author: Crow

env_vars.name: MINIFLUX_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: Admin password for the Miniflux web app. Crow generates it at install and saves it in Settings → Passwords (this machine only); Miniflux creates the admin with it on first start.

env_vars.name: MINIFLUX_DB_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: PostgreSQL password (Docker setup). Generated by Crow at install; never shown.

notes: Self-host via Docker (Crow generates the admin password and saves it in Settings → Passwords) or connect to an existing server (set MINIFLUX_URL + MINIFLUX_API_KEY). Either way, create an API key in Miniflux (Settings → API Keys) and paste it into MINIFLUX_API_KEY.
